claim: data providers let outside AI tools reach their data
Aladdin Copilot, the AI inside the login, is built on the same APIs Studio exposes
It [Copilot] draws on a registry of plugins, “couple of thousands agents and tools,” built by Aladdin’s engineering teams
The first way a team adds a tool is “to define a tool as kind of mapping one-to-one to an existing Aladdin API already out in production”
So Copilot’s tools are Studio’s APIs
Microsoft’s Adrian Crockett made the dependence plain on BlackRock’s podcast (attribution: Adrian Crockett is Microsoft’s; said on BlackRock’s podcast)
